gu.reverend_insanity.moonlight_gu.desc: Fires an azure crescent moon blade (8 dmg, 18m range).
gu.reverend_insanity.liquor_worm.desc: Refines Primeval Essence +1 minor stage higher for 60s.
gu.reverend_insanity.white_boar_gu.desc: Temper body to permanently gain White Boar Strength (+2 Attack).
gu.reverend_insanity.black_boar_gu.desc: Temper body to permanently gain Black Boar Strength (+2 Attack & Armor).
gu.reverend_insanity.jade_skin_gu.desc: Coats skin in emerald jade, granting +6 Absorption HP & Resistance I.
gu.reverend_insanity.little_light_gu.des: Empowers your next Moonlight/Moonglow blade by +50% damage & illuminates targets.
gu.reverend_insanity.stealth_scales_gu.d: Wraps body in fish scales, granting true Invisibility & muffled steps for 15s.
gu.reverend_insanity.vitality_leaf_gu.de: Restores 6 HP immediately and applies Regeneration II for 8s.
gu.reverend_insanity.hope_gu.desc: Awakens the Primeval Aperture and determines D/C/B/A/Extreme Aptitude.
gu.reverend_insanity.moonglow_gu.desc: Launches a piercing sapphire Moonglow slash (14 dmg, 24m range).
gu.reverend_insanity.four_flavors_liquor: Refines Rank 2 Red Steel Essence +1 minor stage higher for 90s.
gu.reverend_insanity.white_jade_gu.desc: Encases body in White Jade armor (+12 Absorption HP & Resistance II).
gu.reverend_insanity.blood_moon_gu.desc: Fires a crimson crescent blade (12 dmg + Bleed Wither II & 30% Lifesteal).
gu.reverend_insanity.moon_raiment_gu.des: Drapes caster and nearby allies in silver lunar silk (Resistance I & Speed I).
gu.reverend_insanity.earth_communication: Listens through the earth to reveal all entities within 48 blocks (Glowing).
gu.reverend_insanity.iron_bone_gu.desc: Forges skeleton into dark iron (+4 Max HP & +40% Knockback Resistance).
gu.reverend_insanity.golden_moon_gu.desc: Unleashes a giant 3m Golden Moon arc (24 dmg, AoE cleave & fiery shockwave).
gu.reverend_insanity.chainsaw_golden_cen: Spins razor-sharp golden buzzsaw mandibles, shredding targets in front (28 dmg).
gu.reverend_insanity.sky_canopy_gu.desc: Forms an indestructible white-gold barrier (+20 Absorption HP & Resistance III).
gu.reverend_insanity.thunder_wings_gu.de: Sprouts wings of purple lightning, dashing 22 blocks forward with brief flight.
gu.reverend_insanity.primeval_stone.desc: Natural crystal filled with Primeval Qi. Restores Primeval Essence & feeds Gu.
